summary: Large installations can get a clean fresh start, and a private installation gets a private AI account.

new.title: One-time fresh start for large installations
new.text: On your request, a one-time cut-off can be set so older records no longer build CIs. CIs built only from them retire with that reason, and nothing is deleted.

fixes.title: Private AI account on private installs
fixes.text: On a private installation the optional AI account is private, or AI stays off and setup says why.
